text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dream stage of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe was finally drawing near.
With the race just around the corner,
Satono Diamond—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Look at that adorable waterfowl over—
choice_data_list: Wait, it's dangerous to go alone!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Come over here too, Trainer~!
It's super cute!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —She seems a little restless.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm sorry for dashing off like that.
So many things caught my eye, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that was only natural,
I posed the question to Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Backed by "Project L'Arc," she had endured grueling training for three long years—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And yet, whether all that effort pays off
is decided in a single race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even I, as a Trainer, feel something intimidating enough to make me flinch.
As I wonder just how anxious she must feel—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"—No.
Not nervous in the slightest."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I feel so exhilarated.
My chest is dancing with overflowing anticipation—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Because the stage is finally set!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"『Winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is a monumental hurdle.』
『Unreachable for Japanese Umamusume.』"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "How many times have I heard those words? Each time, I resolved myself in my heart."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If "World Number One" is such a lofty peak—
—I will definitely show you I can reach it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No one expects an easy victory.
It is precisely because of such a stage that upon winning,
true joy will reach everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If it is "high," I shall surpass it.
If it is "impossible," I shall make it reality—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To share the inspiration born from that is
my true duty as a daughter of the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is why—Trainer-san.
Please, lend me your strength.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To shatter the jinx,
and claim the title of "World's Best"
as a Tracen Academy Umamusume—
choice_data_list: Let's turn the impossible into possible with your brilliance!
Let's make the impossible possible with your brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
On my pride, I will surely—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, carrying the radiance of a jewel in her heart,
Satono Diamond set off for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—
